interfaces.name: capability.ConsumptionStore
interfaces.semantics: Consume atomically increments only below MaxUses; replay exhaustion and conflict are terminal, and every other store error is classified as capability.ErrConsumptionUnknown.

interfaces.name: capability.Resolver
interfaces.semantics: Resolver returns trusted verifier and key lifecycle policy; unresolved or dependency failures grant no authority.

interfaces.name: capability.RevocationChecker
interfaces.semantics: A true result revokes the grant; error is capability.ErrRevocationUnknown and fails closed.

interfaces.name: capability.Service
interfaces.semantics: Issue uses the service's pinned signer, limits and clock; Verify binds exact purpose and audience, checks signature, time and revocation, and does not consume or imply a committed effect. The transaction owner atomically consumes or reserves/finalizes one-time use with the protected domain transaction; existing explicit Grant.Consume behavior is unchanged and every verification or consumption error fails closed.

types.declaration: struct{CapabilityID string; ExpiresAt time.Time; MaxUses uint32}
types.name: capability.Consumption
types.semantics: CapabilityID, expiry, and signed maximum-use bound form one immutable atomic-use identity.

types.declaration: struct{Use uint32; Remaining uint32; Reusable bool}
types.name: capability.ConsumptionResult
types.semantics: Use is the committed ordinal; Remaining is the committed allowance; Reusable is true only when the signed grant requires no consumption store.

types.declaration: struct{Version int; Issuer string; Audiences []string; Subject string; Bearer bool; Resource string; Operation string; IssuedAt time.Time; NotBefore time.Time; ExpiresAt time.Time; ID string; Tenant string; CorrelationID string; MaxUses uint32; Caveats map[string]string}
types.name: capability.Payload
types.semantics: Version is exactly 1; Issuer, Resource, Operation and ID are required and bounded by capability.Limits.MaxFieldBytes; Subject and Bearer are mutually exclusive; Audiences are bytewise sorted, unique, non-empty and bounded by MaxAudiences and MaxFieldBytes; timestamps are non-negative UTC seconds with ExpiresAt after both IssuedAt and NotBefore; NotBefore may precede IssuedAt for planned skew; lifetime from the earlier of IssuedAt and NotBefore is no greater than MaxLifetime; MaxUses is no greater than Limits.MaxUses; Caveats retain the existing bounded map and canonical bytewise key-sorted wire encoding.

types.declaration: opaque secret value with unexported canonical capability-token bytes; zero value invalid
types.name: capability.Proof
types.semantics: Secret bearer or subject-bound proof; configured Limits.MaxTokenBytes bounds construction and verification without a smaller incompatible default. ParseProof uses existing Parse for structural validity only, never authority. Copies share private lifetime state. Transfer synchronously invalidates all copied aliases before one callback outside locks, clears detached borrowed bytes on success/error/panic, never consumes a grant and never retries; callback failures are redacted ErrProofTransferFailed with only safe cancellation classification. Nil context/callback is ErrInvalidConfiguration; zero/transferred proof is ErrInvalidToken; pre-cancellation leaves ownership unchanged. Verification with a snapshot acquired before transfer may finish; later verification fails closed. No implicit string, text, JSON, logging or formatting disclosure; explicit transport copies have caller-owned secret custody.

types.name: capability.Purpose
types.semantics: Names one exact capability operation purpose; no prefix, wildcard, hierarchy or cross-purpose substitution is permitted.

types.declaration: struct{CapabilityID string; Purpose capability.Purpose; Digest [32]byte; ExpiresAt time.Time}
types.name: capability.Reference
types.semantics: Mutable non-secret lookup metadata, never authority. NewReference validates an ID of 1..256 UTF-8 bytes, exact purpose, nonzero caller-supplied digest and positive UTC-second expiry; it cannot authenticate the digest preimage or prove capability existence. Service.Issue derives the documented domain-separated SHA-256 lookup digest from its canonical token. Reconstructed values require validation before storage/use.

types.declaration: struct{Signer capability.Signer; Resolver capability.Resolver; Clock func() time.Time; Limits capability.Limits; Skew time.Duration; Revocations capability.RevocationChecker}
types.name: capability.ServiceConfig
types.semantics: Explicit pinned policy: no implicit limits defaults; callers may select DefaultLimits explicitly. NewService rejects nil signer/resolver/clock, invalid limits and negative skew. Clock is trusted fast local time; collaborators support concurrent calls when shared. Revocations may be nil only under an explicit application policy permitting no revocation source. Collaborator panics are not recovered.

types.declaration: struct{Issuer string; Tenant string; CapabilityID string; KeyID string; Subject string; Resource string; IssuedAt time.Time}
types.name: capability.RevocationQuery
types.semantics: The query is the complete authenticated revocation identity checked after signature and time validation.
